page_title: MNU 2-1 BRE | Manchester Utd v Brentford 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' 2 - 1 Goal! Nice headed pass by Harry Maguire to Scott McTominay (Manchester United), who latches on to it and puts the ball into the back of the net with a fine header. 2:1.
90+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Scott McTominay (Manchester United) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.

83' Substitution. Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) in, Mathias Jensen out.
83' The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.

83' A snap shot by Neal Maupay (Brentford) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Andre Onana produces a good save to thwart him. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' What was Neal Maupay (Brentford) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' Referee Andy Madley signals NO PENALTY for Manchester Utd after a VAR review!
79' One of the Manchester Utd players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

53' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Thomas Strakosha easily deals with the threat.
49' Manchester Utd control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

45' Wasted effort! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
43' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
43' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
42' The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

37' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

37' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Thomas Strakosha.
35' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

16' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
16' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Brentford earn a corner.
15' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
14' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
11' Mason Mount (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
11' Mason Mount (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
10' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
10' Ball possession – 42:58.

5' What a long-range shot by Christian Norgaard (Brentford). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
